text.en: The great Tamil Ramayana by Kamban.

Kambaramayanam, composed by Kamban, is the Tamil retelling of the Ramayana and a high point of Tamil poetry. The textbook gives a memorisation poem from it.
Kamban's verse is praised for its rich imagery, rhythm and depth. The poem shows his skill with description and character.
Terms: கம்பர் (Kamban), இராமாயணம், காண்டம் (book) and மனப்பாடம். Learn the poem with its meaning.
